answer: The cedar schedule is applied in zephyr and canyon exposes each instalment. A payout is split and therefore 40% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4596 identities would post 3897 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
